title: "Map"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(rnaturalearth)
```

```{r}
read_csv("data/mallards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  head(10)
```

```{r}
read_csv("data/mallards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  count(duck_id, sort = TRUE)
```

```{r}
read_csv("data/mallards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  summarise(
    min_lat = min(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_lat = max(lat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_long = min(long, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_long = max(long, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
mallards <- read_csv("data/mallards.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    timestamp = as.POSIXct(timestamp),
    month = month(timestamp, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    month_num = month(timestamp),
    year = year(timestamp),
    season = case_when(
      month_num %in% 3:5 ~ "Spring",
      month_num %in% 6:8 ~ "Summer",
      month_num %in% 9:11 ~ "Autumn",
      month_num %in% c(12, 1, 2) ~ "Winter"
    ),
    season = factor(
      season,
      levels = c("Spring", "Summer", "Autumn", "Winter")
    )
  )

saveRDS(mallards, "data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

countries <- ne_countries(
  scale = "medium",
  returnclass = "sf"
)

mallards |>
  filter(
    between(lat, 47, 55),
    between(long, 8, 25)
  ) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = countries,
    fill = "gray95",
    color = "gray60",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(x = long, y = lat, color = duck_id),
    size = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(8, 25),
    ylim = c(47, 55),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Duck GPS Locations",
    subtitle = "Individual duck movements across Europe",
    x = "Longitude",
    y = "Latitude",
    color = "Duck ID"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      ncol = 4,
      override.aes = list(size = 2, alpha = 1)
    )
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold")
  )
```
